bench_e2e.title: End-to-end SQL bioseq.load + mmsearch vs minimap2 (2/4 Gbp dna4/dna5)
bench_e2e.description: Default 2/4 Gbp E2E comparison: bioseq block aligner + SIMD nthash/SIMD chaining, Vulkan GPU seeding+chaining + block aligner, and minimap2. bioseq runs through bioseq.load + SELECT mmsearch; minimap2 runs via CLI on the split FASTA. no_index = from-scratch build+map counted; just_index = index prebuilt untimed, then measured COLD after a PostgreSQL restart.

test_case_descriptions.E2E_2GBP_DNA4: dna4 2 Gbp reference, one 5 Mbp HiFi-error query (DOC0283 seed)
test_case_descriptions.E2E_2GBP_DNA5: dna5 2 Gbp reference with deterministic N bases; same biological parameters as dna4
test_case_descriptions.E2E_4GBP_DNA4: dna4 4 Gbp reference, one 5 Mbp HiFi-error query; minimap2 ref split into two records
test_case_descriptions.E2E_4GBP_DNA5: dna5 4 Gbp reference with deterministic N bases; same biological parameters as dna4
